levels.title: Runner Showcase
levels.blurb: A 60s handcrafted course: chains, staircases, gaps, a gravity flip, a corridor and a climax.

levels.title: Radial Practice
levels.blurb: Four directions converging on the centre ring.

levels.title: Prototype 90s
levels.blurb: The full multi-mode song map: all four modes and their transitions.

levels.title: Runner Benchmark V2
levels.blurb: One continuous 30-second RUNNER course, authored as a single arc rather than a pattern list: 6s teach, 8s development, 6s gravity transformation, 6s climax, 4s release. The reference for how the movement language should feel end to end.

levels.title: Runner Golden Courses
levels.blurb: Three hand-authored courses proving the movement language at three tiers: EASY/TEACH (10s, no inversion), MEDIUM/FLOW (16s, one gravity transition), HARD/CLIMAX (18s, inversion, ceiling movement, restore).

levels.title: Runner Readability Demo
levels.blurb: Six short RUNNER sections, one per visual idea: plain running, single-jump rhythm, a multi-jump phrase, platform variation, gravity inversion, and a faster rhythmic close. Built to check the two-layer visual language -- nothing decorative in it may be mistaken for geometry.

levels.title: Runner Procedural — Seed 7
levels.blurb: Procedurally composed RUNNER course (spec §44–§48): the loader expands course.generate through composeCourse, then plans it like any authored level.

levels.title: Toosie Slide — Arena Primary
levels.blurb: Arena-dominant multi-mode arrangement: 75% Arena across four recurring motifs, with Runner, Radial and Vertical as single-section excursions at the phrase boundaries (bars 18-24, 41-48, 56-59).

levels.title: Toosie Slide — Dance Golden
levels.blurb: The whole song as one mode: 22 hand-authored Rhythm Breakout phrases, each played twice — the phrase, then its mirror at double speed — and nothing else. 44 rounds, two inputs at the start and ten at the end, with the relief sections sitting on the breakdowns. The reference chart for the dance language.
